# lodash.isplainobject v4.0.6

The [lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.isPlainObject` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.isplainobject
```

In Node.js:
```js
var isPlainObject = require('lodash.isplainobject');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#isPlainObject) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.0.6-npm-packages/lodash.isplainobject) for more details.
